indomethacin_iv_held_out_profiles.cohort: Six healthy volunteers in one intravenous indomethacin study
indomethacin_iv_held_out_profiles.validation: Leave-one-subject-out, with one shared curve per training set
indomethacin_iv_held_out_profiles.fit_objective: Unweighted sum of squared natural-log concentration residuals
indomethacin_iv_held_out_profiles.model_assumptions: Instantaneous IV input and first-order elimination from the central compartment. The two-compartment model adds reversible, first-order distribution.

model_equations.two_compartment: C(t) = A exp(-alpha t) + B exp(-beta t), alpha > beta > 0

indomethacin_iv_held_out_profiles.scope: Same-study prediction over the sampled 0.25 to 8 hours. The two-compartment fit summarizes early and late decline. Enterohepatic recycling described by the original investigators is outside these equations. Prediction in another cohort, brain exposure and clinical response require independent evidence.

ecopipam_parent_total_plasma.model: one-compartment oral limit with apparent parameters

linezolid_unbound_auc_ratio.cohort: neurocritical care, paired samples at steady state
